intro: Twogether is your all-in-one solution for compact living. Dual mattresses, smooth pull-out storage, and handy utility shelves ensure it delivers on comfort, convenience, and style in equal measure.

features.title: Strong enough to handle heavy use
features.text: Built with a metal frame made of CRCA steel pipes, this diwan bed provides a sturdy and long-lasting foundation, perfect for both lounging and sleeping.

features.title: Smooth pull-out mechanism for easy conversion
features.text: The pull-out system operates on rollers and magnets, allowing for seamless transition from diwan to bed.

features.title: Mattresses designed for day and night use
features.text: Comes with two premium mattresses that ensure even weight distribution, giving you both daybed comfort and nighttime support.

features.title: Storage drawers to keep things tidy
features.text: Twin drawers beneath the mattress provide ample space to neatly store blankets, pillows, or seasonal items, keeping your room clutter-free.

features.title: Sleek headboard storage for added convenience
features.text: The diwan’s headboard storage section features a durable mat membrane surface, ideal for holding books, décor, or gadgets within arm’s reach.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
